title: Capture corrections as reviewed specification debt before policy change
narrative: Human corrections should become structured candidate specification debt linked to failing scenarios, with review before policy changes and regression tests afterward. Soft-to-hard promotion with provenance exists in `taloneth_insp_rule_promotion`. Tracks MH-PA-07[^insp-pa-07].
implementation: PromotionRecord / promote_soft_to_hard / rollback_promotion and failure attribution helpers. Desired: correction→test feedback loop and first-class specification-debt ledger.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-PA-07, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
